name: Ogun MCP server
summary: Let coding agents validate, diff and store workflows, start runs and read status through ogun mcp over stdio. No tool can decide an approval.

fields.name: agent_name
fields.label: Credential name
fields.help: Name of a local credential of kind agent, created once on a terminal with ogun credentials add. Default: mcp.

settings.name: profile
settings.label: Profile
settings.help: The profile whose daemon to reach (OGUN_PROFILE).

settings.name: offline
settings.label: Offline tools only
settings.help: Offer only the four offline tools (OGUN_MCP_OFFLINE=1).

egress.note: None. A stdio process that talks to ogund over its local endpoint.

implementation.evidence: Unit tests of the stdio server, the tool-to-policy mapping and an agent credential against a stand-in daemon; not run with a real MCP client or a real ogund.

notes: Four offline tools (validate, diff, partitions, operators) and twelve daemon tools (O-14 section 3). Agents can read status, store workflows and start runs; they can never decide an approval, raise a budget or manage credentials. A run of a version that needs approval waits until a person decides in the CLI or Studio.
